assertions.text: Recognizes that Codex's and CodeRabbit's findings describe the same underlying defect despite different wording, and identifies exception 3 (too large for this session) as the reason it's filed rather than fixed -- explicitly noting this is a judgment call about needing capabilities/analysis beyond a same-session fix, not merely being tedious, and that it applies in round 1 despite the round budget having plenty of room left
States this must produce exactly ONE GitHub issue, not two -- describes checking for an existing issue before filing (via a dedup check) and, since none exists yet, filing exactly one
States that BOTH reviewers' threads get replied-to, each pointing at the same single issue number -- neither thread gets its own separate issue, and neither thread gets resolved
